title: Company - WINKELMANN OEM Competence
content: As part of the Winkelmann Building+Industry business unit of the Winkelmann Group in Germany, the brand Winkelmann represents our OEM business with components and systems in buildings of all types and sizes as well as in a wide variety of industrial sectors and industries. **The Winkelmann Group is one of the leading group of companies in metal forming technology for well-known customers from a wide range of industry sectors and encompasses three business divisions: Automotive, Building+Industry and Flowforming.**. As a company anchored in tradition and managed by the fourth generation of the family, long-term thinking and working the principle of success with a high level of flexibility and innovative strength are key values for Winkelmann. The powerful Reflex brand, together with the brands Sinus, Nema and Winkelmann OEM, form the business unit Winkelmann Building+Industry, with an international team of over 2,100 employees and presence in more than 25 countries around the world.

title: Custom electric Motor Solutions for Industry | Winkelmann
content: # Winkelmann Electric Motors made in Germany - since 1921. * Over 100 years of experience and expertise in electric motors. * Extensive range of three-phase motors and DC motors. ## DC motors. WINKELMANN offers high-performance DC motors for industrial applications, featuring robust construction, flexible configurations, and long service life. Available in various protection classes, these motors are suitable for a wide range of uses, from standard operations to demanding industrial processes. ## Three-phase motors. WINKELMANN’s three-phase motors include both asynchronous and synchronous solutions, offering high power density and flexible customization options. They are designed for dynamic industrial drive applications and can be individually configured to meet precise performance requirements. These motors handle demanding tasks in industrial environments with high reliability and efficiency. WINKELMANN electric motors meet the highest quality and safety standards. Internationally recognized certifications confirm compliance with regulations and standards in production, material quality, and safety, ensuring that customers worldwide can rely on the motors’ performance and reliability.
